sections.text: مقدمة

This document out lines 
speed control and speed protection maintenance procedure P1 to be performed on 
an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the
above title block

This
system
control & protect the Gas Turbine, consist of:
speed 
sensor & speed connection device:
102412, UT 464 2A, ELXT 5514 a, PT 5501a , VT5507

The 
first draft initiated by eng. Mohamed Aly Aly Hassan, tested by eng.Al 
Shahat Ahmed Mousa at 01 March 2003, revised by EDEPCo. quality control eng. Adel El-Meniem 
Al Emam, accepted by General Director 
eng. Hamdy Abd El Moola Melegy, approved by eng. Yousry Mohamed Aly Salama 
Alam Head Sector of Al Shaba GT Power Station, 
and certified by eng. Aly Mostafa AL Lethy EDEPC inspection and 
 quality control head sector.
احتياطات السلامة

A work permit must be issued 
 and the qualified maintenance staff should be carry the
فئة السلامة المناسبة,

Safety fence with 
 caution marks surrounding the work area,

ارتداء خوذة السلامة الخاصة بك، والأحذية
. Etc
Ensure that the Gas Turbine is out of service, at cold state

sections.text: الأدوات والمعدات
Dry Air Blower
Multimeter and connection wires
Contact cleaner.
العمل المراد تنفيذه
Measure the voltage of the card and take the number of it.
Record the results in the test sheet.
Check values according to the setting values.

If these values changed compared with the setting values then adjust this values 
using resistance (012-R3)

If this values not accepted after adjusting then replace the card with a 
new one and adjust it according to the given values.
